description: This file defines a Unity MonoBehaviour script named EventSystemChecker that ensures an EventSystem exists in the scene. If no EventSystem is found when the script awakes, it creates a new GameObject with the EventSystem and StandaloneInputModule components.

classes.name: EventSystemChecker
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour that ensures an EventSystem exists in the scene, creating one if absent.

methods.name: Awake
methods.description: Unity lifecycle method called when the script instance is being loaded. Checks for existing EventSystem and creates one if necessary.
